fields.title: Cracking Your Dream Job Interview
fields.description: Join this intensive session where a Senior Software Engineer at Google shares insider tips on acing technical interviews, behavioral questions, and salary negotiation. Whether you are applying to FAANG or African startups, this webinar is for you.

fields.title: From Student to Tech Leader
fields.description: An inspiring session with the CTO of a leading African tech startup who will share his journey from studying computer science in West Africa to leading a 50-person engineering team. Learn the mindset shifts required to go from developer to leader.

fields.title: Breaking into AI & Machine Learning
fields.description: A Machine Learning Engineer at Meta walks you through the roadmap to break into AI/ML in 2026. Topics include which skills to prioritize, portfolio projects that get noticed, and how to navigate the AI job market from Africa.

fields.title: Scholarship Application Masterclass
fields.description: A comprehensive walkthrough of how to write winning scholarship applications for Indonesian universities. Covers motivation letters, recommendation letters, and interview preparation.
